description:
Preparation document (docs/F1_5_GPU_OPS_INVENTORY.md, Turkish,
plan-only - no production code) for package F1-5: the pure
operation inventory the OpenDRT + NODES GPU pass will be built
from, read against the F1-1/F1-4 CPU references now on main
(ColorModel.h/.cpp, OpenDrt.h/.cpp) and the shipped develop chain
(GpuDevelopPipeline.cpp, ChainSlots.h, GlesShaderSources.kt).

Sections cover the current chain inventory (11 draws, 6 texture
units, 79 glUniform call sites, the absent uniform-limit query),
a per-node GLSL op table for ColorModel (which half of the node
math is CPU-compiled into uniforms versus per-pixel, and why the
512-entry composite curve tables must ride a 1D R32F atlas rather
than uniforms), an OpenDRT stage-by-stage op table (~200 MAD +
~25 transcendentals per pixel; the Impl constructor constants map
straight to uniforms; SDR/HLG differ only in the tail block), the
33-cube
changed: docs: add F1-5 GPU ops inventory for nodes and opendrt
